systems.owner: Agence nationale des registres (the administration, transitionally, until the Agency's organs are installed)
systems.tiers: national digital register of Moroccans and foreign residents, who may apply for inscription; holds biometrics and assigns the Identifiant digital civil et social

note: Law 72-18 (enacted 2020-08-08) creates the population register, the unified social register and the Agence nationale des registres; it says nothing of civil-status offices or how births and deaths are registered.
